description:
AI Fashion Stylist that helps shoppers effortlessly discover complete, stylish looks using real products from popular stores.
Users can simply mention a desired style or occasion (casual, formal, minimal, etc.) to receive a fully personalized outfit or upload a clothing item image to get a “Complete My Look” experience.

Stylist recommends personalized  complete looks using real, available products.

1. Connect the elfai app to ChatGPT.
2. Type Commands: Simply type “@” then choose the elfai app
3. Generate: You are ready to go! 
Upload an image to use 'Complete My Look' or Try asking specifically:
“Recommend a casual outfit”

defaultPrompt: Find me an outfit for business meeting.
